metadata.description: Spec-driven development workflow for Claude Code: OpenSpec cycle, specialised agents, mandatory review, git guardrails, CI — installed in any project from its own code.

plugins.name: sdd-core
plugins.description: /sdd-init (reverse-documents a project and installs the workflow), passation, retro, domain-modeling, improve-codebase-architecture

plugins.name: sdd-ui
plugins.description: Optional UI skills: web-design-guidelines, break-ui, emil-design-eng, animate, review-animations, improve-animations

plugins.name: openspec-cockpit
plugins.description: Desktop app only: OpenSpec cockpit pane (next action, cycle timeline, task groups, decisions), gate alerts, status line. Pairs with the `cockpit` option of sdd-init.

plugins.name: conversation-cards
plugins.description: Desktop app only: Claude's messages as cards (questions, reports, QA, commits, cockpit block) and the display contract.

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: Desktop app only: session band above the prompt (context, cost or rate limit, time, tools, model, background count).

plugins.name: background-tasks
plugins.description: Desktop app only: background pane listing services with their port and workflow runs with phases and agents.
